frontier_selector.why: Lumbar MRI and contrast-enhanced abdominal CT findings of a well-circumscribed lesion with heterogeneous enhancement decided it

support_spans: Lumbar MRI revealed a well-circumscribed 5 cm lesion in the left retroperitoneal space, adjacent to the iliopsoas muscle, with low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and high signal intensity on T2-weighted images
a 52×47 mm mass anterior to L4, abutting the left ureter and left common iliac artery, with heterogeneous enhancement
contradict_spans: Brain and chest CT scans were normal
